Definition: from G1415; to be efficient (figuratively):--be mighty.
BiblicalUsage: To be able, to be powerful, as God is able to make all grace abound toward us, and He is able to make a man stand whom others would judge. Paul says Christ is not weak toward the Corinthians but mighty in them, and the power that proves itself is Christ's, not his.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God is able to make all grace abound, and the proof is that He has already made me stand. The Christ who is mighty in me is the same Christ who is able to keep me.
